bug.summary: src.vector_store.query_cases reconstructed RetrievedCase objects without carrying supply_chain_nodes from data/historical_cases.json.
bug.old_behavior: RetrievedCase.supply_chain_nodes defaulted to an empty list after Chroma retrieval.
